notes.title: Guntouchables v 1.0.6 - Gun tweaks
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Preppers![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]The [b]1.0.6 patch[/b] is here, and this time we’ve focused heavily on guns. Balance changes are always a bit controversial, but they’re also necessary to keep as many weapons as possible feeling viable, fun, and fair. We’re confident these updates will improve the experience once you’ve had a chance to adapt, and we’re excited to see how you use them![/p][p][/p][h3]🔧New Accuracy System[/h3][p]The old accuracy system had its flaws, and unreliable randomness often led to frustrating results, especially when firing less accurate weapons.[/p][p]With [b]1.0.6[/b], accuracy now works differently:[/p][list][*][p]The longer you fire in rapid succession, the less accurate your weapon becomes.[/p][/*][*][p]Controlled bursts remain precise, even with weapons like the SMG.[/p][/*][/list][p]This means inaccurate weapons can now be used skillfully, and accuracy becomes a more meaningful factor when choosing mods and milestones.
We believe this makes combat more tactical and rewarding, while still keeping the arcadey feel that defines the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44826120/812ff8c592fe0a1aa797254a1e9de7529442dd64.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🖥️UI Improvements[/h3][p]We have updated the way we display damage for shotguns and burst-firing weapons (Assault Rifle) to make it more clear. We now display the total damage output per click, but also the damage per pellet/bullet and the number of pellets/bullets per click. Hopefully, this will make it more transparent how damage is affected when applying mods and milestones to these weapons.[/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][h1][b]Weapon Changes:[/b][/h1][p][/p][h3]Pistols[/h3][table notes.title: Unleashing the heat! Guntouchables v. 1.0.5 is out
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Preppers![/h1][p][/p][p]Some of you have been getting [i]way[/i] too good at the game... like, seriously impressive levels of good. Right now, Heat is capped at level 15, but you’ve shown us just how much we underestimated you. So we’ve raised the Heat cap all the way to [b]level 35[/b]![/p][p]We haven’t been able to properly test the higher levels ourselves (we can’t get past mission 3 so far 😅), so we’d love your feedback on how it plays once you push the limits. ːGWarriorː[/p][p][/p][h3]ːGUNTOUCHABLESː Stability & Network Fixes ːGUNTOUCHABLESː[/h3][p][/p][p]We’ve also worked on improving stability and addressing reported network issues. Since we couldn’t reproduce these problems on our end, it is very difficult for us to conclude how impactful these improvements are. If you previously had trouble with unstable connections, please let us know if things are running smoother now. You can either share it on the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2543510/discussions/3/"]Steam forums[/url] or in the [url="https://www.game-swing.com/discord/"]Discord[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]ːGUNTOUCHABLESː New in Guntouchables 1.0.5 ːGUNTOUCHABLESː[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Fixed:[/b][/p][list][*][p]'Full Heath' Extra gets applied instantly after the vote[/p][/*][*][p]Colliders on containers in Urban levels[/p][/*][*][p]Secret clues sometimes pointing in the wrong direction ːsteamfacepalmː[/p][/*][*][p]Gunmods can no longer disappear upon rejoin[/p][/*][*][p]Fix Linda's Hip Fire Perk[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Changed:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved text sizes on SteamDeck[/p][/*][*][p]Player Bots do a better job avoiding bile pools[/p][/*][*][p]Technical optimizations to improve network performance and stability [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Added:[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now see more information about the current expedition inside the missions[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now unlock up to 35 levels of Heat![/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3]ːGUNTOUCHABLESː Future development ːGUNTOUCHABLESː[/h3][p][/p][p]We’re currently working on the [b]Bunker Update[/b] - a cozy playable hub where you’ll be able to:[/p][list][*][p]Pick expeditions[/p][/*][*][p]Test firearms[/p][/*][*][p]Spend beans for upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Track your progression[/p][/*][*][p]…and much more over time ːGNymphː[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re aiming to release the Bunker Update in [b]late September[/b].[/p][p]Beyond that, we’re reviewing all existing game content. This will be an ongoing process, with smaller periodic updates that add tweaks, changes, and new elements between the bigger updates.
[/p][p]As always, if you want to support the game - share your feedback, spread the word and get the Supporter Pack - it helps us improve Guntouchables more than anything else![/p][p][/p][p]Bullets & Beans![/p][p][/p][p]Game Swing [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3768260/GUNTOUCHABLES__Supporter_Pack/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: New Guntouchables update (v. 1.0.4) is adding text chat
notes.content: [h1]Hello Preppers![/h1][p][/p][p]We’ve heard you loud and clear! - you wanted better ways to communicate with your squad in-game. With the [b]1.0.4 update[/b], we’re excited to introduce [b]text chat[/b]! Just hit '[b]Enter'[/b] and type away to coordinate strategies, request healing or ammo, or simply connect with your teammates.[/p][p][/p][p]This update is a little bigger than the previous updates, and we are really excited to share it with you. If you've been following some of the recent Steam posts, you already know that we have been working hard to address the most critical feedback and your most highly requested features. [/p][p]As always, thank you so much for your feedback - it helps us make the game better![/p][p][/p][h3]What's new in 1.0.4:[/h3][h3][/h3][p][b][u]⌨️In-game text chat[/u][/b][/p][p]You have requested better ways to communicate and connect with the other players in the game. Guntouchables 1.0.4 will introduce a brand-new text chat feature, allowing players to request healing or ammo, sync strategies or whatever else they find a need to communicate.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]🥾Tools for inactive players[/u][/b][/p][p]The new update add functionality allowing the host to kick other players from the game to prevent someone who is inactive from blocking further progress.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]🎒Consumable drop option[/u][/b][/p][p]Pressing "R" when holding a consumable, will now put it back on the ground. This will make it easier to optimize the distribution of consumables between the players.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]🎮Steam Deck improvements[/u][/b][/p][p]We have made some visual tweaks to make the game look better on the smaller screen on the Steam Deck.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]💾Player progression backup[/u][/b][/p][p]Unfortunately, some players have been unlucky and lost progression. As much as we would like to, we cannot help restore this progression. However, we are looking to add a solution that would help players restore their progression if this should happen again in the future.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]🔧Bug fixing and performance optimizations[/u][/b][/p][p]We are making ongoing efforts to improve the game's performance. We know that some players have reported issues related to unstable online connection. We are making continuous efforts to identify and solve these issues.[/p][p][/p][p]We really hope you will enjoy these additions and continue to support the game![/p][p][/p][p]XOXO,[/p][p][/p][p]Game Swing[/p]

notes.title: Duos and Trios coming to Guntouchables - v. 1.0.3 is out
notes.content: [h1]Hello Preppers![/h1][p][/p][p]We’ve got a little surprise for you before the weekend hits. 🎉[/p][p]While we’re still cooking up some bigger features for future patches, we wanted to squeeze in a smaller [/p][p]update you’ve been asking for. Starting in [b]Version 1.0.3[/b], teams or 2 or 3 players can now play [b]co-op without bots [/b]and face the challenge on your own terms, and at your own discretion. One word of caution - playing fewer than 4 players will make the game harder![/p][p]This change comes straight from your feedback, and it's a new feature we are testing out. Keep those ideas coming, they’re helping us shape Guntouchables into something even better. 💪[/p][p][/p][p]Below is a list of what changes the new update introduces.[/p][p][/p][h3]New in Guntouchables 1.0.3[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Fixed:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed Blackscreen-softlock in room transition state[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tooltips and popup cards shown outside screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed nav mesh causing issues in antenna missions[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Changed:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Splash screens are skippable[/p][/*][*][p]Limited difficulty scale on fewer than 4 players[/p][/*][*][p]Changed version string from timestamp to build number[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Added:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added functionality to Open / Close slots in lobby[/p][/*][*][p]Added "New Update" available notification[/p][/*][*][p]Added FAQ Link in multiplayer for common issues[/p][/*][*][p]Various smaller fixes and optimizations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][u]The following issues are not included in 1.0.3 but are high priority in one of the upcoming updates:[/u][/p][list][*][p]Ensuring inactive players cannot block the game[/p][/*][*][p]Introducing better options for communication in-game[/p][/*][*][p]Adding functionality to drop a consumable[/p][/*][*][p]Adding a notification to players for when to update to a newer version of the client[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.game-swing.com%2Fdiscord%2F"]Join the Guntouchables Community on Discord![/url][/h3][p]We are paying attention to your feedback on the Steam Forums, but we highly recommend joining the amazing Guntouchables community on [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.game-swing.com%2Fdiscord%2F"]Discord[/url]. Here you can find players for groups, discus meta and share experiences, and post feedback/suggestion to the dev team.[/p][p][/p][p]Now go enjoy that bot-free co-op and have an awesome weekend![/p][p][/p][p]XOXO,[/p][p][/p][p]-Game Swing[/p]

notes.title: Guntouchables v. 1.0.2 is now live
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Preppers![/h1][p][/p][p]It’s been 5 days since launch… and wow, what a ride! 🚀
[/p][p]Over [b]2 million copies[/b] were claimed in the first 24 hours alone, smashing every expectation we had. We’re blown away, and incredibly grateful for all the excitement, support, and kind words you’ve been sharing with us. ❤️[/p][p]
A special thank you goes out to those of you who’ve run into bugs or issues and still took the time to report them. Whether it’s small tweaks or major fixes, your feedback is helping us target the areas that make the biggest difference.[/p][p]
We’re a tiny dev team of just 5 people so we don't have the resources of a AAA team. Therefore, every message, every report, and every bit of encouragement means the world to us. Together, we’re making Guntouchables better, smoother, and more fun for everyone.[/p][p][/p][h3]New in Guntouchables 1.0.2[/h3][p]We are ready to release the second post-launch update to Guntouchables notes.title: Guntouchables is now paid after being claimed by over 2 million preppers!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Preppers![/h1][p][/p][p]The 24 hour free period is over, and Guntouchables is now available for $4.99 for anyone who didn't claim it during this period. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you so much to everyone who has shown interest!!!
[/b]
Launching free for 24 hours was a huge bet for us, and we are thrilled to announce that more than 2 million players claimed the game!!! This is absolutely insane, and has blown all our expectations for getting the game off the ground.[/p][p][/p][p]If you have claimed the game and are enjoying the experience so far, we want to remind you that you can support the continued development of Guntouchables by purchasing the Supporter Pack.[/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3768260/GUNTOUCHABLES__Supporter_Pack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]We know some of you are experiencing issues, bugs and are requesting critical features - We hear you and are on the job![/h3][p][/p][p]Guntouchables is made by a very small dev team of just 5 people, so some things may take a little time. notes.title: Challenge rooms & Enemies!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Preppers![/h2]

Welcome old timers and all the new players who joined us in the latest playtest! Thank you all for participating in the "Bring A Friend To The End" playtest, we got some great insights into the current stability of the game and the late-join feature. We really appreciate all the discussions and banter you brought to the [url=https:/game-swing.com/discord]Discord server[/url] as well. 

We are currently focusing on the missions to tie them better to the world setting and giving you a harder challenge, that's really exciting and feel like this will improve the experience a lot. So look forward to more information on that in the next Dev Update! 
Here is a small teaser[i] [Disclaimer: This is very early progress and could change before launch][/i] [previewyoutube=04hDF6yGyS4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Challenge rooms[/h3]
Red means danger!
We’ve got a nasty surprise for anyone who thinks red crates come too easy.

Weapon crates (yes, the red ones) have always been a reliable source of rare firepower. But power like that deserves a fight.

Enter: Challenge Rooms - a set of disgusting, arena-style encounters that lock the doors, crank up the tension, and make you earn those beautiful crates.
These rooms are built to stress-test teamwork, spike adrenaline, and inject a bit more chaos into your scav runs. We’ve had a blast running early versions internally (turns out tight spaces and spitter swarms are a crowd-pleaser), and we can’t wait to see how they play in the wild.
Naturally, we’re already plotting weirder, meaner variants.

Got ideas for awe-inspiring layouts, eclectic enemy combos, or chaotic modifiers that would absolutely ruin someone’s day (in a fun way)? Let us know. We’re listening.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826120/a6637a53240a641d6fb86fbc66051a753ef8e064.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=sGUb365SG_Q;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Runner dog enemy[/h3]
A new strong runner type enemy with a powerful explosive attack. The pulsating biles are ready to explode on touch so you better get out of the way!

... And are you even allowed to release a game without a dog these days? (Just don't pet this one)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826120/348c9ff3a4d551df7e6d4312bc2dad0eabcae0f3.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=MIU9PiKCqIs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Changelog[/h3]
Along with the featured updated above we have done a bunch of changes in other areas as well.

[b]General Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Added various new player perks
[*] Added rarity visuals to perks, weapons and mods
[*] Added visuals to armor
[*] Added new 'Bile Dog' enemy
[*] Added Decoy consumable, which draws aggro from enemies over time
[*] Added challenge rooms, a dynamic room that can be added to any map
[*] Added new enemy mutations and blessings
[*] Changed weapon crate (red crate) interaction to be handled by challenge rooms
[*] Changed so all players start with dash as default
[*] Removed Running perk because all players start with dash
[/list]
[b]Singleplayer[/b]
[list]
[*] Added ping commands to drone companion
[/list]
[b]Gameplay Weapon[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed so weapon mods carry over when replacing a weapon
[*] Changed so players have 2 weapon slots and a pistol that cannot be replaced
[*] Added various new weapon mods
[/list]
[b]UI / UX[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed of most UI buttons and layout with 'bunker' theme
[*] Changed Ryan Gossip visuals
[*] Changed visuals for using consumables
[*] Changed visuals for using medkit on self and others
[/list]
[b]Sound[/b]
[list]
[*] Added New gun sounds
[*] Added New ambiences
[*] Tweaks to voices
[*] Added Multiplayer gun system so other players gun sounds are lower and have less low end
[/list]
[b]Meta[/b]
[list]
[*] Added stats for characters, mutants, weapons and perks
[*] Added 'undiscovered' element to perks, mutations and weapons that the player has yet to try
[/list]
[b]Networking[/b]
[list]
[*] Added late-join to allow players to join a running game up until the end of the first mission
[*] Added rejoin to allow players to reconnect to a game they have been disconnected from
[/list]

Thanks for following the latest additions and improvements. Remember the discussion continues in the [url=https://www.game-swing.com/discord]Discord server[/url]!

XOXO,

Game Swing

notes.title: New singleplayer companion, Enemies, Compendium and Status Effects!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Preppers![/h2]

We've been keeping a low profile since Steam Next Fest, but now, as we gear up for Early Access, our development is really picking up speed. Our top priority is ensuring the game shines at launch, and we are thrilled to share some of the latest additions to the game.


[h3]Meet Your New Flying Friend[/h3]
Being a game with mechanics designed specifically around co-op, you need a companion that can assist you with different acts and actions. We have used an AI-controlled player bot to support you with cover fire and revives when playing solo. However, the feedback from the playtest and Next Fest has clearly indicated that a lot of you were feeling frustrated or confused by this solution.
The demands for the solo bot are way different from its multiplayer siblings, and we want that to be obvious.

So, we´re pumped to reveal this brand-new drone that will follow you around and act as your wingman when flying solo!

The drone will autopilot, but you can also give it orders with the pinging system (middle mouse button).
We are incredibly excited about this, as it will open some very cool opportunities, like upgrading the drone.

Check it out and tell us what you think... oh, and while you´re at it, do you have any good suggestions for what we should call this fella?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826120/482343acd5af7b82b6109b2b86de8da5669e0046.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=D9lmQguCh1A;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Prepper's Handbook[/h3]
We're thrilled to announce that we’re creating a comprehensive compendium, designed to showcase the vast array of content within the game and to give you an idea of all the things you can encounter and unlock through playing. An example of this is the "bestiary," where you can see details about enemies and their mutations. This will be perfect to casually verify your conspiracy theories, or for the hardcore nerds who want to memorize every single detail and secret of the game. This is still in the early phases, but the general idea is that we have a place to gather information about your overall progression and show you how to progress further.

We'd love to hear your opinions on what would be cool to see in a compendium. Have you tried games that did this well?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826120/fccc36fc34e1db13359a0c761093f15a71513923.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826120/84e1f25ea7d61f42d9bd9ea07682f154e887747f.png[/img]

[h3]Improving UI and Communication: Status Effects[/h3]
We have several systems affecting both players and mutants that were shamefully uncommunicated during Steam Next Fest. Many of the perks that gave you quick boosts and bonuses were firing off behind the scenes like a surprise piñata but with zero confetti to celebrate.

To clear the fog, we have created new systems and UI to display all this glorious info. This has resulted in a lot of interesting finds. For instance, Linda's "Lethal Positivity" perk (Killing an enemy with the shovel increases your damage) now tends to encourage chasing a combo multiplier as it stacks (See attached image).
In addition, the movement penalty incurred when walking through corruption now feels much more severe because of the added clarity.

It’s a work in progress and a bit of a balancing act.
We want the game to be clear about information while remaining intuitive and easy to engage with, so it might take some iterations to determine the optimum level of detail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826120/6e1914a9ebd5a2e64aaace4dae8657a79b6a5843.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826120/3b0678e7edda788e9f1a6bdfdc9ad8e4f02307ae.png[/img]

[h3]Enhanced Gun Noises[/h3]
The gun sounds were implemented a very long time ago. So Christopher (sound guy) decided they were about as exciting as a wet sock, and replaced them all to give the guns more punch than a charging Wartusk.

Check out the video below!

[previewyoutube=DNUTJElazTo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Ideas for New Common Enemies[/h3]
One of our persistent goals for Guntouchables is to create variety. From one run to the next, the experience should be meaningfully different so you feel engaged and excited to keep playing the game. Special enemies with unique abilities are always especially exciting... and WE WILL get to those. However, one of the areas we believe will have a higher immediate impact is adding more common enemies. At this point, 3 out of 4 starter enemies are the same for every single run, across every excursion. So if we expand the roster of starter enemies, you should experience greater variety in how runs begin, and not just how they progress over time. Designing common enemies presents a unique challenge, as they serve primarily as cannon fodder. If they become too intricate or specific in their actions, their sheer numbers can easily create (undesirable) chaos and become overwhelming. Yet, we’re determined to give them distinctive behaviors to ensure the change goes beyond mere appearance.
Here are two potential ideas we’re exploring:
[list]
[*] [b]Grub: [/b]A small foe that charges at players when it has a line of sight.
[*] [b]Hermit: [/b]A heavily armored foe that can pull back into its indestructible shell.
[/list]
Can you guess what happens if you shoot at the shell?

We’d love to hear your thoughts and feedback and we’ll keep you posted on our progress.
However, it’s important to set expectations—these concepts are still in the brainstorming phase and may change during prototyping, with no guarantee of making it into the final game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826120/659fb6575feb63c6c1b56630d43ef1b35fa1d2a2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826120/67f09dee3f4d2eb0ce5b50c0f81670953bf5e3df.png[/img]



Thanks for following the latest additions and improvements. Remember the discussion continues in the [url=https://www.game-swing.com/discord]Discord server[/url]!

XOXO,

Game Swing

notes.title: Next Fest Demo is Live!
notes.content:
[h2]Heads up, Preppers!
[/h2]
Guntouchables will be playable as a demo during Steam Next Fest for the next week. First of all, thanks to everyone who joined the playtest. Your feedback has helped tremendously, and we are grateful for all your kind words and constructive criticism on our Discord. Your excitement is infectious!

But you know what’s not infectious? Baxter’s Bunker Beans - possibly the most nourishing low-mercury containing meal you could ask for in a post-apocalyptic world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826120/223509b9cefab8d9d17f9cca6cb6a5a7faa1d521.png[/img]

Baxter’s Bunker Beans is not just an enjoyable snack, it is also the de-facto currency in the few places left where bartering takes place. Baxter himself will buy back any unopened cans of Baxter’s Bunker Beans you find out in the wastelands, in exchange for perks and weapon unlocks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826120/54647c5b24b4ce59a45139e0101d3a6a731708fd.png[/img]

Brick Baxter is also taking time out of his busy schedule as a post-apocalypse entrepreneur to provide valuable tips for new players of Guntouchables in the form of Brick Tips. Enjoy the first episode here:

[previewyoutube=bLpofsLLwko;full][/previewyoutube]

We have of course been hard at work adding a lot to the game since the playtest, while also fixing a lot of the issues and balancing that many of you helped uncover. Again, thanks to all of you for helping us along the way; our Discord has become a bustling and wonderful place to spend time with you while we work on the game. And if you’re not already part of the growing and awesome pro-prepper community that is Guntouchables, you can join the discord [url=https://discord.com/invite/wvrBAxu]here[/url].

We’ll try our best to keep you posted on our progress as we go along. And if you’re just joining us, then welcome to the wastelands, prepper - and thanks for joining  the most friendly post-apocalypse community.

Enjoy the demo during next fest, it will be available until [b]3rd March, 7 PM CET[/b]. Play alone, with your friends, the LFG channel on our discord, or join a game through the server list. Wether alone or in a group, you can turn the wastelands into a prepper’s paradise.


[i]With much love,
The Game Swing Team[/i]

notes.title: Closed Alpha Wrap-up + Development Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Preppers![/h1]

It's been 2 weeks since we stopped the Closed Alpha playtest to focus on the next big milestone in Guntouchables' development - [b]Steam Next Fest![/b]

We didn't know what to expect from the Alpha playtest, so we were absolutely blown away by the results and the reception. An overwhelming 20.000 players signed up to participate in the Alpha playtest during the 13 days it was live, and the feedback we received was nothing short of invaluable. Bugs were reported, opinions were shared, and balancing was discussed... and we are learning so much! ːsteamhappyː

[b]A huge THANK YOU goes out to each and everyone who participated![/b]

As you may suspect, two weeks is not nearly enough time to process all the feedback we received during the Alpha test. However, we have worked our butts off to include as many cool changes and features as possible. Especially for those players requesting an extra challenge! ːDevil2ː

[h3]Here is a list of what you can expect: [/h3]

[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unlocked the 'Apocalypse' excursion
[*] Added new boss to the 'Apocalypse' excursion

[*] Changed difficulty scaling between missions

[*] Added a new ingame shop, where you can unlock game content from
[/list]
[h3]Visuals:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the visuals for selecting excursion
[*] Changed visuals for the destructible crates
[*] Changed the visuals for bean cans
[*] Changed the visuals on game-over and game-won showing amount of crates and beans the player collected
[/list]
[h3]Sound:[/h3]

[h3]Other:[/h3]

[*] Added new Steam Achievements (29 in total)

notes.title: First changelog since the January open playtest
notes.content:
[b]Summary[/b]
Each mission now has side missions, so beside the main goal of retrieving the UpCrates™ the players have different side-objectives that will pay out cash to spend in the armory.

Players can now pick from the whole weapon arsenal if the have the cash to pay for it.

We've added a lot of new maps and enemies.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] New environments: Facility
[*] New side-mission types: Repair the antennas, Destroy the nests, Exterminate the enemy breeders, Free the civilians
[*] New enemies: New base enemy, and elemental mutations for most enemy types (Fire spitter, Ice runner, Bile bugs etc)
[*] Destructible walls
[*] Final boss: New map layout and tweaked 
[/list]
[b]UI/Meta[/b]
We've worked a lot with explaining the systems to the players in an easy to digest way.
[list]
[*] Player cash
[*] Shop
[*] New progression overview
